Vacancy Listing Dates 8/07/2026 to 5/08/2026
Please Quote Reference Number 17537
- Immediate start available
- Remuneration - $80,000 - $100,000
- Join the team at BCE Surveying - Based in Bunbury

BCE Surveying is a Licensed and Engineering Surveying company operating throughout Australia with offices in Perth, Bunbury and Sydney. Specialising in providing innovative solutions to all aspects of Civil Construction, SMP, Machine Guidance, Investigation Surveys, Terrestrial Scanning and Mobile Laser Scanning most recently Utility and 3D Subsurface mapping services.

BCE run the Trimble MX8 which is a premium survey grade mobile laser imaging system capturing fully synchronized, high-quality georeferenced point clouds and high-resolution imagery, this vehicle-mounted system is the only one of its kind in Australia.

Additionally, BCE also runs the IDS GeoRadar System which is a mobile GPR system (CART) capturing subsurface artefacts as high-resolution imagery similar to a CAT Scan of the ground.

They require a Surveyor to join their team in Bunbury, WA.

Key responsibilities include:
- Conduct Site Surveys. Prepare for civil engineering projects by leading surveys and compiling information about proposed project sites.
- Prepare Blueprints and Specifications. Support surveyors civil engineers by preparing specification sheets for entire projects or components.
- Estimate Material Needs and Costs. Maintain project budgets by estimating material needs and costs based on project specifications.
-Inspect Construction Sites. Conduct periodic inspections of sites and monitor surveyor activities.
- Perform Material Testing. Taking soil samples and analyzing them as required as well as conducting tests on construction materials and elements as required at the surveying site.
- Prepare Project Reports. Prepare progress reports, presenting them to surveyors, civil engineers and other personnel. Compare project timelines and costs to expectations and report on potential delays or issues that arise during construction.

To be considered you will need a relevant bachelor degree or higher qualification and at least two years of post-qualification employment experience as a Surveyor.

This is a full time position, an immediate start is available. A remuneration package of $80,000 - $100,000 per annum will be offered to the successful candidate.

APPLY NOW through the application form - https://www.netyourjob.com.au/jobs/17537.php

result.description:
About the Role  
  Randstad is partnering with a key Federal Government department to recruit an experienced   Communication Manager (EL1 Equivalent)  .  
  Operating with a high degree of autonomy, you will provide strategic advice and lead the planning, design, and delivery of integrated communication initiatives across major business areas. Sitting within a dynamic, high-performing governance and communications division, you will collaborate with specialists across media, digital, design, and strategy to amplify key messages, drive engagement, and deliver high-impact communication outcomes.  
  Role Responsibilities  
  Reporting to the Director of Communication and Media, your main responsibilities will include:  
 
  Strategic Communication:   Partner with internal business areas and senior leadership to design and deliver integrated internal and external communication strategies and plans aligned with operational priorities.  
  Trusted Advisory:   Act as the primary communications point of contact for allocated business functions, delivering authoritative advice and building strong stakeholder relationships.  
  Content Development:   Translate complex or technical information into clear, engaging, and audience-tailored products across multiple digital and traditional channels.  
  Digital & Platform Governance:   Oversee digital content management across platforms, managing publishing workflows and ensuring full compliance with Australian Government digital and accessibility standards.  
  Team & Workflow Leadership:   Lead, direct, and mentor a small team - setting priorities, managing shared mailboxes, and allocating resources to deliver high-quality outputs under tight deadlines.  
  Evaluation & Continuous Improvement:   Monitor, evaluate, and report on campaign outcomes to continuously enhance engagement and strengthen brand visibility.  
 
  Key Selection Criteria  
 
  Current Australian Government  Baseline Security Clearance   mandatory.   
  Demonstrated professional experience in a communication, public relations, or strategic engagement role within a complex organizational environment.  
  Relevant tertiary qualifications in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, or a related field.  
  Demonstrated experience administering and managing digital communication platforms (e.g.,   GovCMS  ,   Confluence  ) including overseeing content publishing, workflow governance, and digital accessibility compliance.  
 
 How to Apply 
 If you meet the requirements above and hold an active Baseline clearance, click  APPLY NOW  

 At Randstad, we are passionate about providing equal employment opportunities and embracing diversity to the benefit of all. We actively encourage applications from any background. 
   
    Please  click here  to apply.
